items.title: Jasper Taylor Interview, 1959-06-30
items.q: A lot of dance dates and pick his musicians. And every time he could, uh, cause I were, uh, the earlier part of the nights, generally I were, uh, in the theater. If there's any way that he could wake me in on the date.

ctx.x: I understood he had a band sometimes that go out of town and travel. Did you ever travel on any tour with him?

No, I didn't travel on any tour. Just around town. He would get a lot of dates himself. A lot of dance dates and pick his musicians. And every time he could, uh, cause I were, uh, the earlier part of the nights, generally I were, uh, in the theater. If there's any way that he could wake me in on the date. Uh, if it run late, well, he would do so. Uh huh.

Of other New Orleans, uh, drummers, do you remember any, uh, others you mentioned, Cottrell, who first came up. Do you remember any of the other bands that came up like when Joe Oliver's band first came up?
